revision.hashCaveat: Captured after successful runs, not atomically at launch. Main sources/fixtures unchanged since their corresponding runs. Supporting target/classes and full unit dependency classpath were reused, not independently pinned at run time.

reproduce.prerequisites: Java 21, Node, existing local MySQL installation, prebuilt supporting classes and cached JDBC/Spring dependencies; no installation performed.

fix.cause: Connector/J may buffer an entire server-returned text value before getCharacterStream exposes it. Client reader/output limits alone do not bound returned fields.
fix.projection: For validated non-scalar columns: LEFT(CONVERT(quoted_column USING utf8mb4), fieldCharacters), with a separate CHAR_LENGTH(CONVERT(quoted_column USING utf8mb4)) > fieldCharacters flag. Scalar columns keep their bounded typed conversions.
fix.predicates: Equality remains quoted_original_column = prepared_parameter. No caller-controlled SQL expressions. Trusted internal numeric limit literals only.
fix.truncation: Any server-prefix flag marks the result partial even if serialized output fits. rows counts complete serialized rows, including complete rows with partial cells, not source matches or incomplete serialized rows.
fix.bounds: Per row, UTF-8 text value payload <= maxBytes, plus <=128 bytes per scalar and <=1 byte per text flag; result metadata/protocol overhead is additional. LIMIT <= requested limit + 1, max 201. This is not a bound on server scan/conversion work or exact JVM RSS.

results.measurementMethod: Forwarding JDBC instrumentation reads actual returned value bytes and samples SHOW SESSION STATUS LIKE 'Bytes_sent' on the same connection immediately before the production SELECT and after its ResultSet closes. Delta includes metadata/status-query overhead; it is not TLS packet capture. Assertions require field <=1024 bytes, row values <=1025 bytes and delta >0 and <=9216 bytes. It does not substitute data or execute an alternative bounded query in place of production SQL.
additionalRealChecks: Full original-value text predicate succeeds while matching only its truncated prefix fails.
One complete serialized row with partial text reports rows=1 and truncated=true.
NULL and exact 256-character boundary do not falsely report truncation.
Prior numeric, timeout, cancellation, rollback, SELECT-only grant, schema, metadata, row/output limits still pass.

isolation.credentials: Generated ephemeral account password only; no password values or initialization log retained.
isolation.server: Fresh private datadir/HOME/socket; --no-defaults first; random loopback port; TLS REQUIRED; root locked; SELECT-only fixture account; X protocol and local infile disabled.
isolation.cleanup: Runner exited 0 after terminating owned server and deleting private datadir/credentials.
remainingCaveats: TLS uses local generated certificate without identity verification.
Output budget may cut mid-row; partial output is notes, not guaranteed standalone JSON.
Source work is timeout-controlled but LEFT/CHAR_LENGTH can still require server-side scanning/conversion of a large source cell.

acceptanceReview.reason: Does not add full destructive/multistatement/file/side-effect attack matrix or before/after database-state audit; earlier gaps remain.
Adds real large-field and protocol-byte evidence, but pagination, log responses, 429/transient retry budgets, stalled-I/O hard deadlines and UI/final-answer completeness remain untested.
